# Original LEZAC.EXE level-2 debris SHATTER PLAYBACK and REST-COUNTER evidence.
#
# Tick-locked, one 64 KiB DS pread per tick, debris record table DS:0x2093
# stride 0x0B. Bombs eleven drops at the level-2 sites with the deepest free
# fall (tile (40,31) has 16 clear tiles below it) so fragments build enough
# vertical speed to trip the landing-shatter gate (4AED cmp vy,0x3c).
#
# 1. SHATTER PLAYBACK, previously disassembly-only. The spec listed the
#    0x76 -> 0x77 -> 0x78 -> terminal chain as never exercised. It is captured
#    here, ONE GLYPH PER TICK, on a record whose flagged word is 0xc007 --
#    below the 0xffbc fragile floor -- so the terminal is the 0xFF dissolve
#    rather than the 0x6b+Random(5) fragile terminal. The record's slot is
#    reused seven ticks later, i.e. the 0xFF consume path removed it. This
#    confirms the port's stepper (one frame per tick) and its non-fragile
#    terminal choice.
#
# 2. REST COUNTER: the port's retirement model is REFUTED by these rows. The
#    port reads 4CFF (cmp rest,0x64) as "after exactly 100 resting ticks,
#    clear bit 0x8000 and remove the record". The original does not do that.
#    The counter SATURATES at 100 and the record stays: across this capture
#    and the natural-forward capture, no record's rest byte ever exceeds 100,
#    bit 0x8000 of its word is never cleared, and the record is never removed
#    on that path. Removal is observed only through the 0xFF consume path
#    The longest observed run is 3359 CONSECUTIVE TICKS at rest == 100
#    (record 205, from frame 641 to the end of the capture) -- the port would
#    have removed that record after 100. The port's behaviour is left
#    unchanged in this change -- the
#    replacement model needs its own verification pass -- but the divergence
#    is recorded here rather than carried silently.
debris_shatter_playback_original=level2
source=LEZAC.EXE via DOSBox /proc/mem tick-locked read
runtime_ds=0c8f
debris_table_offset=0x2093
debris_stride=0x0b
ticks_sampled=3920
shatter_record=202
shatter_chain=0x76,0x77,0x78,0xff
shatter_chain_frames=498,499,500,501
shatter_ticks_per_glyph=1
shatter_word=0xc007
fragile_floor=0xffbc
terminal_is_dissolve=1
slot_reused_frame=508
landing_shatter_gate=0x3c
max_vy_observed=68
rest_max_observed=100
rest_saturates=1
longest_rest_100_run=3359
longest_rest_100_record=205
rest_retirement_observed=0
damaged_bit_ever_cleared=0
port_retirement_model_refuted=1
visual_claim=0
temp_copy=1
